name: 36109 · Montgomery, AL
findings: ZIP 36109 (Montgomery) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36109 (Montgomery) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 36109 (Montgomery) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
